title: Hyperinsulinemic-euglycemic Clamp Protocol
author: Li Kang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yyafxse

steps.title: Surgical Preparation
steps.instruction: Perform surgical catheterization of the carotid artery and jugular vein in mice at least 5 days prior to the study day.

steps.title: Initial Mouse Preparation
steps.instruction: Weigh the mouse and initiate fasting by placing the animal in a plastic container with fresh bedding (suggested start time between 7:00 and 8:00 AM).

steps.title: Equipment Setup
steps.instruction: Set up microrenathane tubing to swivel and connectors as needed.

steps.title: Reagent Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary reagents for the procedure.

substeps.instruction: Collect donor blood (Reagent 1).
Prepare tracers if needed (Reagent 3, Reagent 4).
Prepare insulin (Reagent 2).

steps.title: Tracer Loading (If using [3-³H]glucose)
steps.instruction: Draw tracer infusate into a 1 ml syringe and place it securely into the pump slot.

steps.title: Line Priming
steps.instruction: Fill the lines to prevent air infusion into the mouse.

substeps.instruction: Fill the arterial line with heparinized saline, leaving the sampling syringe connected to the top of the swivel.
Fill the venous line with non-heparinized saline (or tracer, if using [3-³H]glucose).

Plug the free end of the 3 cm microrenathane tubing going into the venous port of the swivel (A) or the free end of the 3 cm tubing going into the 3-way connector if using [3-³H]glucose (B) with a stainless steel plug.

steps.title: Mouse Connection (If using [3-³H]glucose)
steps.instruction: Weigh the mouse and connect it to the microrenathane tubing approximately 100 minutes prior to the start of the clamp.

steps.title: Baseline Tracer Infusion
steps.instruction: Begin baseline primed-continuous tracer infusion at least 90 minutes prior to clamp start (typically a 1.2 μCi prime followed by a 0.04 μCi/min continuous infusion).

steps.title: Protocol Documentation
steps.instruction: Prepare Protocol sheets using mouse weight, insulin dose, sample times, and volumes.

steps.title: Infusate Loading
steps.instruction: Draw the following into separate 1 ml syringes and place them securely into pump slots: glucose infusate (50% dextrose mixed with or without [3-³H] glucose), insulin infusate, and donor blood.

steps.title: Infusate Line Connection
steps.instruction: Connect 10 cm microrenathane tubing to each infusate syringe and connect the tubing to a 4-way connector. Fill each line with glucose, insulin, and donor blood infusates up to the 4-way connector.

steps.title: Initiate Donor Blood Infusion
steps.instruction: Once the last basal sample is taken, stop the baseline tracer infusion pump (if using [3-³H]glucose), connect the 4-way connector to the 3 cm microrenathane tubing connected to the swivel infusion port, and begin donor blood infusion.

steps.title: Start Clamp Study
steps.instruction: Once donor blood reaches the mouse, start the study by beginning insulin and glucose infusion.

steps.title: Blood Sampling for Plasma Metabolites
steps.instruction: Collect blood samples from the arterial line.

substeps.instruction: Insert a blunt syringe into the free end of the arterial line prior to releasing the clamp.
Release the clamp and draw the desired volume of blood into the syringe.
Clamp the arterial line and remove the syringe.
Dispense blood into a 0.5 ml EDTA tube and mix by flicking.
Centrifuge for 1 min at 16,000 g.
Transfer plasma to a labeled 1.5 ml tube (store on ice temporarily or at –20ºC permanently).
Re-insert the sampling syringe into the arterial line, pull back slightly to remove air bubbles, and slowly return ~20–40 μl of blood until the line is lightly red to clear.

For 14C- or 3H-2-deoxyglucose: Add 196 μl ddH2O to 4 μl standard and vortex; pipette 50 μl diluted standard into 1.5 ml tube and add 950 μl ddH2O; pipette 100 μl into scintillation vial; add 900 μl ddH2O and 10 ml scintillation fluid; measure in liquid scintillation counter.
For [3-3H]glucose: Dilute tracer standards 1:200 in saturated benzoic acid (5 μl in 995 μl).
Add 10 μl diluted standard to three vials (CS), add 990 μl ddH2O and cap.
Add 10 μl diluted standard to three vials (CSE) and set aside for drying.

Add 10 μl diluted standard to three 1.5 ml tubes; add 10 μl saline, 100 μl diluted Ba(OH)2, and 100 μl diluted ZnSO4; vortex and spin 5 min at 16,000 g; transfer 100 μl supernatant to vials (CRS) and set aside to dry.
Add 10 μl plasma sample and 10 μl saline to a 1.5 ml tube.
Add 100 μl diluted Ba(OH)2 solution and 100 μl diluted ZnSO4 (Ba(OH)2 first).
Vortex and centrifuge (5 min at 16,000 g).
Pipette 100 μl of supernatant into a scintillation vial.
Dry in oven with a trap for 3H2O (include CSE and CRS standards).
Add 1 ml ddH2O and 10 ml scintillation fluid and measure radioactivity.
Optional: To determine 3H2O accumulation, pipette 50 μl supernatant into a second set of vials without drying; 3H2O is the difference between non-dried and dried samples.
Keep tissues and 5 ml tubes in liquid nitrogen; cool forceps in liquid nitrogen.
Weigh tissue sample (~60 mg or total available), transfer to 5 ml tube in liquid nitrogen.
Place tube on ice and homogenize in 1.5 ml 0.5% perchloric acid; keep on ice.
Centrifuge 20 min at 2000 g at 4°C.
Transfer 1.25 ml of supernatant (or total available) to 13 ml tubes on ice.
Neutralize sample (pH ~7.5) using KOH and HCl; record volumes used.
Centrifuge 10 min at 2000 g at 4°C.
Prepare Vial A (2-DG phosphate and 2-DG): Add 125 μl neutralized supernatant and 875 μl ddH2O.

Prepare Vial B (2-DG only): Pipette 250 μl neutralized supernatant into 1.5 ml tube; add 125 μl stock 0.3N BaOH and 125 μl stock 0.3N ZnSO4; centrifuge 5 min at 16,000 g; add 250 μl supernatant and 750 μl ddH2O to vial.
Add 10 ml scintillation fluid to each vial and measure radioactivity; 2-deoxyglucose phosphate is the difference between A and B.
